lines.zh: {i}一段时间之后……{/i}

lines.en: scene bathmale1
Okay, so, before you ask: Yes, this is a bathhouse.
lines.zh: 好吧，在你们开口问之前先说清楚：对，这里是澡堂。

lines.en: And no, I have not been here before.
lines.zh: 还有，不，我以前没来过。

lines.en: Hell, I didn’t even realize Kumon-mi had a bathhouse until approximately half an hour ago when I found out our water had been shut off for some reason.
lines.zh: 见鬼，我直到大约半小时前发现家里不知道为什么停水了，才知道 Kumon-mi 还有澡堂。

lines.en: And given that it’s already the middle of the night and that the water company is closed, the {i}four{/i} of us were left with no other option but to come here.
lines.zh: 而鉴于现在已经是深夜，水务公司也下班了，我们{i}四{/i}个人别无选择，只能来这儿。

lines.en: Yes, that’s right. I said {i}four{/i} of us.
lines.zh: 对，你没听错。我说的是{i}四{/i}个人。

lines.en: Maya and Ayane were planning on staying the night as well.
lines.zh: Maya 和 Ayane 也打算在这里过夜。

lines.en: And before you go getting all excited about what this could possibly mean, allow me to break your heart.
lines.zh: 而在你开始对这可能意味着什么兴奋起来之前，请允许我先伤一伤你的心。

lines.en: This is not a co-ed bathhouse...meaning I need to bathe alone while the other three do whatever it is girls do when they’re in the bath together.
lines.zh: 这不是男女混浴的澡堂……也就是说我得一个人洗，而另外三个则在女浴那边干着女孩一起泡澡时会干的事。

lines.en: Which is probably bathe.
lines.zh: 大概就是洗澡吧。

lines.en: But the more exciting side of me likes to believe it’s something else.
lines.zh: 不过我性格中比较亢奋的那部分，更愿意相信是别的事。

lines.en: I guess on one hand, though, it {i}is{/i} kind of beneficial to be in here alone.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，一个人在这里也{i}有{/i}好处。

lines.en: if amifingered == True:
Having both Ami {i}and{/i} Ayane in the same bath as me might be problematic for a number of reasons.
lines.zh: 让 Ami {i}和{/i} Ayane 跟我泡在同一个池子里，可能因为种种原因会很麻烦。

lines.en: Would I like to have that happen regardless of any potential issues that might arise? Absolutely.
lines.zh: 不管可能会出现什么问题，我都想让那发生吗？当然想。

lines.en: But I guess being apart from them is the safer option after all.
lines.zh: 不过，跟她们分开果然还是更保险的选择。

lines.en: else:
Having Ayane in the same bath as me might be a bit of an issue when it comes to hiding the, uhh, {i}nature{/i} of our relationship from Ami and Maya.
lines.zh: 让 Ayane 跟我泡在同一个池子里，在向 Ami 和 Maya 隐瞒我们关系的，呃，{i}性质{/i}这件事上，可能会有点麻烦。

lines.en: Sure, I’m positive that they’re well aware of {i}her{/i} feelings by now, but I doubt they’d want to be around when she attempts to capitalize on them.
lines.zh: 当然，我敢肯定她们现在早就清楚{i}她{/i}的感情了，但我不觉得她们愿意在她试图把感情兑现的时候还待在旁边。

lines.en: scene black
scene bathmale2
I take my clothes off and move through the door to find an exceedingly large open-air bath.
lines.zh: 我脱掉衣服，穿过门，眼前出现一个极大的露天浴池。

lines.en: And, as expected, there are no other men in sight.
lines.zh: 不出所料，看不到别的男人。

lines.en: This is a good thing.
lines.zh: 这是好事。

lines.en: Don’t get me wrong, I’m not afraid of other men or anything like that- I just prefer when the bath isn’t overcrowded with penises.
lines.zh: 别误会，我不是怕别的男人之类的——我只是不喜欢浴池里挤满鸡巴。

lines.en: scene bathmale3
I step into the water and immediately sit down.
lines.zh: 我走进水里，立刻坐了下来。

lines.en: The hot summer air mixed with the heat of the bath is actually somewhat comforting, in a way.
lines.zh: 夏夜的热空气和浴池的热气混在一起，某种意义上反而挺舒服的。

lines.en: You’d think that two different levels of extreme heat would be enough to exhaust you but, for some reason, that doesn’t seem to be the case.
lines.zh: 你会以为两种极端的热度加起来足以把人烤垮，但不知为什么，似乎并不是这样。

lines.en: I sigh to myself as my body temperature rises and am suddenly stricken with an idea that only the protagonist of an erotic game would have.
lines.zh: 随着体温升高，我暗自叹了口气，然后突然被一个只有色情游戏主角才会有的念头击中了。

lines.en: : I can hear the girls from here...
lines.zh: : 从这里能听见女孩子们的声音……

lines.en: In addition to the lack of penises, the lack of noise creates a much easier atmosphere to eavesdrop in.
lines.zh: 除了没有鸡巴之外，没有噪音也让偷听的氛围好了很多。

lines.en: I hush my breathing and direct my full attention to what wonders must lie on the opposite side of this bamboo fence...
lines.zh: 我屏住呼吸，把全部注意力投注在这道竹篱笆另一边必定存在的奇观上……

lines.en: scene black
jump girlbathx
label girlbathx:
scene girlbath1
: ...And that’s how I found out I was allergic to Penicillin.
lines.zh: : ……我就是这样发现自己青霉素过敏的。

lines.en: : Wait...weren’t we talking about reality shows? How did we wind up discussing your medicine allergy?
lines.zh: : 等等……我们刚才不是在聊真人秀吗？怎么变成讨论你的药物过敏了？

lines.en: : Idunno. It just kind of happened, I guess. Does it really matter?
lines.zh: : 我不知道啊。就这么顺着聊过来了吧，大概。有那么重要吗？

lines.en: : Ami, why even bother asking Ayane something like that?
lines.zh: : Ami，你干嘛还要问 Ayane 这种问题？

lines.en: : Turning conversations into endless rants about weird stuff is kind of her specialty.
lines.zh: : 把天聊成关于奇怪东西的没完没了的碎碎念，算是她的专长。

lines.en: scene girlbath2
: Hey, wait a second! That’s not true! I have plenty of interesting things to say that aren’t random!
lines.zh: : 喂，等一下！才不是呢！我有很多有趣的话可以说，又不是全是随口乱扯！

lines.en: : Huh? I never said you didn’t.
lines.zh: : 哈？我又没说你没有。

lines.en: : Maya kind of has a point, though. I feel like any time we wind up on a weird topic, you’re the one to blame.
lines.zh: : 不过 Maya 说得有道理。我觉得每次我们聊到奇怪的话题，罪魁祸首都是你。

lines.en: scene girlbath3
: Well forgive me for having interesting thoughts and opinions!
lines.zh: : 那原谅我有有趣的思想和见解吧！

lines.en: : What does that have to do with a Penicillin allergy?...
lines.zh: : 这跟青霉素过敏有什么关系？……

lines.en: : Everything, Maya. {i}Everything.{/i}
lines.zh: : 全都有关系，Maya。{i}全部{/i}。

lines.en: : What’s the point of having friends if you can’t share every single thought you have with them?
lines.zh: : 如果不能把自己每一个想法都分享给朋友，那交朋友还有什么意义？

lines.en: scene girlbath4
: Uhh...I’m not sure I want to hear about every single thought you have, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 呃……我可不确定想听你的每一个想法，Ayane。

lines.en: : I’ve heard the way you talk about my [uncle]...It’s not very...reserved.
lines.zh: : 我听过你谈论我[uncle]的方式……那可一点都……不矜持。

lines.en: : Ditto. Please at least wait until I have more clothes on to discuss anything about that man.
lines.zh: : 同感。至少等我多穿点衣服再讨论那个男人吧。

lines.en: : Words alone are enough to make me feel gross about this entire situation.
lines.zh: : 光是听到那些词，就足够让我对这整件事感到恶心了。

lines.en: scene girlbath5
: Of course it’s not reserved. Why would I need to be reserved about the man I’m in love with?
lines.zh: : 当然不矜持了。对我爱上的男人，我为什么要矜持？

lines.en: scene girlbath6
: Wait, love?! Who said anything about love?!
lines.zh: : 等等，爱？！谁说爱了？！

lines.en: : I did, just now.
lines.zh: : 我啊，刚刚说的。

lines.en: : Aren’t you a little too [young]to be in love?...
lines.zh: : 你是不是太[young]了点，还不懂什么叫爱？……

lines.en: : Ami, don’t listen to her. Love knows no bounds, and I am in love with your [uncle].
lines.zh: : Ami，别听她的。爱是没有界限的，而我爱上了你的[uncle]。

lines.en: : In fact, I have already talked with him and the two of us have decided to name our first child Ami, after you.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我已经和他谈过了，我们俩决定给我们的第一个孩子取名叫 Ami，就用你的名字。

lines.en: scene girlbath7
: How the heck is that supposed to make me feel better?! There are already more than enough Ami’s!
lines.zh: : 这到底要让我怎么好受啊？！Ami 已经够多的了！

lines.en: : There’s only one, though.
lines.zh: : 可只有一个啊。

lines.en: : Exactly! One is the limit! Name your baby Maya or something instead!
lines.zh: : 就是啊！一个就是上限！给你的宝宝取名叫 Maya 什么的去！

lines.en: : As flattered as I am to hear that, I think you accidentally just agreed to her fostering your [uncle]’s child.
lines.zh: : 听到你这么说我很荣幸，不过我觉得你刚刚不小心同意了让她抚养你[uncle]的孩子。

lines.en: scene girlbath8
: Ami, I...I don’t know what to say...I never thought that you’d agree to this without a fight...
lines.zh: : Ami，我……我不知道该说什么……我从没想过你会不打一架就同意……

lines.en: : In fact, all these years, I kind of had a feeling you might have liked-
lines.zh: : 事实上，这么多年，我隐约有种感觉，你可能也喜——

lines.en: : Wait a second! I never agreed to anything like that! And if you’re about to accuse me of what I think you’re about to accuse me of, I will drown you!
lines.zh: : 等一下！我从没同意过那种事！如果你要指控我我以为你要指控的那件事，我就把你淹死！

lines.en: scene girlbath9
: Woah. You don’t normally get {i}this{/i} defensive whenever I talk about this kind of stuff.
lines.zh: : 哇哦。平时我聊这种事，你不会{i}这么{/i}有防御心的。

lines.en: : Did something happen between you and Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你和 Sensei 之间发生什么了吗？

lines.en: scene girlbath10
: H-Happen? What would possibly happen between us? We’re family. Hahahah...
lines.zh: : 发、发生？我们之间能发生什么？我们是家人啊。哈哈哈……

lines.en: : Hmm...
scene girlbath11
: I guess you’re right. I don’t know about you, but Sensei would never stoop to doing unsavory things with someone he’s related to.
lines.zh: : 我想你是对的。我不知道你怎么想，但 Sensei 绝不会堕落到和有血缘关系的人干那种下流事。

lines.en: : That would be flat-out disgusting. Hahahah~
lines.zh: : 那简直是恶心透顶。哈哈哈~

lines.en: scene girlbath12
: Tch-!
if amifingered == True:
: Who are you calling disgusting, blondie?
lines.zh: : 你说谁恶心呢，金毛？

lines.en: : If it’s any consolation, I don’t think you’re disgusting, Ami.
lines.zh: : 如果这算安慰的话，我不觉得你恶心，Ami。

lines.en: : You stay out of this, Maya. This isn’t your fight.
lines.zh: : 你别插嘴，Maya。这不关你的事。

lines.en: : Understood.
lines.zh: : 明白。

lines.en: else:
: {size=-15} I wouldn’t be so annoyed if that wasn’t true.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-15}如果那不是真的，我也不会这么生气。{/size}

lines.en: scene girlbath13
: Listen, Ami. I’ll stop talking about my relationship with Sensei if it makes you happy, okay?
lines.zh: : 听着，Ami。如果聊我和 Sensei 的关系让你不开心，我就不说了，好吗？

lines.en: : I get that I can be a little obsessive sometimes, but I’ll try to tone it down if it means preserving our friendship.
lines.zh: : 我知道我有时候是有点执着，但如果这意味着能保住我们的友情，我会尽量收敛。

lines.en: scene girlbath14
: Wait, why are you suddenly being all nice? How am I supposed to be mad at you when you say things like that?
lines.zh: : 等等，你为什么突然这么好？你说这种话，我要怎么对你生气啊？

lines.en: : I’m just being honest. My relationship with Sensei is something that you shouldn’t need to hear about.
lines.zh: : 我只是实话实说。我和 Sensei 的关系，是你不需要听的东西。

lines.en: scene girlbath15
: Umm, okay...but can you stop saying “My relationship with Sensei?”
lines.zh: : 嗯，好吧……不过你能不能别再说「我和 Sensei 的关系」了？

lines.en: : It makes it seem like something is actually going on between you two.
lines.zh: : 那听起来像是你们俩之间真有什么似的。

lines.en: scene girlbath16
: Oh? Silly me~ I guess I’ll need to be more careful with my phrasing in the future.
lines.zh: : 哦？我真是傻了~看来我以后得更注意措辞了。

lines.en: scene girlbath17
: What did you do?
lines.zh: : 你做了什么？

lines.en: : Hm? What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 嗯？什么意思？

lines.en: : What did you do, Ayane?
lines.zh: : 你做了什么，Ayane？

lines.en: : You didn’t tell him how you feel, did you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会告诉他你的心意了吧？

lines.en: : {i}Ami...{/i}This is your {i}[uncle]{/i} we’re talking about...Do you really think I would do something like that?
lines.zh: : {i}Ami……{/i}我们在说的是你的{i}[uncle]{/i}……你真觉得我会做那种事？

lines.en: : Yes. Now tell me what you did.
lines.zh: : 会。现在告诉我你做了什么。

lines.en: scene girlbath18
: I didn’t do anything that wouldn’t have eventually happened on its own~
lines.zh: : 我没做任何本来就不会自然而然发生的事~

lines.en: scene girlbath19
: Maya.
lines.zh: : Maya。

lines.en: : Huh? What?
lines.zh: : 嗯？什么？

lines.en: : Will you call the police on me if I kill her?
lines.zh: : 如果我把她杀了，你会报警吗？

lines.en: : Uhh, I think I left my phone at your house.
lines.zh: : 呃，我想我把手机落在你家了。

lines.en: : Good.
lines.zh: : 很好。

lines.en: scene girlbath20
: Hey, hey, there’s no need to kill anybody. I really didn’t do anything. I promise.
lines.zh: : 嘿，嘿，没必要杀任何人啦。我真的什么都没做。我保证。

lines.en: : And even if I did, you’re the last person I would tell.
lines.zh: : 就算做了，我也是最不可能告诉你的那个人。

lines.en: scene girlbath21
: Why is it that all of the things you say to cheer me up do the exact opposite?!
lines.zh: : 为什么你说的每一句用来安慰我的话，效果都恰恰相反？！

lines.en: : Which ring in Hell do you reside in, demon?! And why must you steal the one thing I love?!
lines.zh: : 你住在地狱的第几层啊，恶魔？！你为什么非要偷走我唯一爱的东西？！

lines.en: scene girlbath22
: I'd hate to interrupt this loving exchange between two best friends, but do either of you have any shampoo I can borrow?
lines.zh: : 我实在不想打断两位好朋友之间这充满爱意的交流，不过你们谁有洗发水能借我用用吗？

lines.en: : I just realized I’ve been washing my hair with only water for almost five minutes now.
lines.zh: : 我刚意识到自己已经只用清水洗了快五分钟的头发了。

lines.en: scene girlbath21
: Okay. Never mind.
lines.zh: : 好吧。当我没说。

lines.en: : Ami, I’m really not stealing anything, I promise.
lines.zh: : Ami，我真的什么都没偷，我保证。

lines.en: : Even I know how crazy it is to imagine that Sensei would actually devote himself to someone like {i}me{/i}.
lines.zh: : 就连我也知道，幻想 Sensei 会真心对{i}我{/i}这样的人有多疯狂。

lines.en: scene girlbath23
: Well then stop saying such weird stuff all the time! I don’t like it.
lines.zh: : 那就别老是说这种奇怪的话！我不喜欢。

lines.en: : I know you like him but he’s still my [uncle]. Isn’t there supposed to be some kind of code that prevents you from making a move on him or something?
lines.zh: : 我知道你喜欢他，可他还是我的[uncle]。难道不该有什么规矩，禁止你向他出手之类的吗？

lines.en: : Who said I’m going to make a move?
lines.zh: : 谁说我要出手了？

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure {i}you{/i} have like, eight hundred times by now.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定到现在的{i}你{/i}已经出手大概八百次了。

lines.en: : You literally told me you were gonna name your baby after me a few minutes ago.
lines.zh: : 你几分钟前还亲口说要给宝宝取我的名字呢。

lines.en: : I was joking. And besides, you already said there is an Ami-limit, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 我开玩笑的。再说，你自己不是说了 Ami 有上限吗？

lines.en: : It wouldn’t be right of me to steal your [uncle] {i}and{/i} your name. So if it’ll make you happy, I’ll stay away from both.
lines.zh: : 把你的[uncle]{i}和{/i}你的名字都抢走，这样不合适。所以如果这样能让你开心，我两个都不碰。

lines.en: : Well...thank you Ay-
lines.zh: : 嗯……谢谢你，Ay——

lines.en: scene girlbath24
: There is {i}one{/i} condition though.
lines.zh: : 不过有{i}一个{/i}条件。

lines.en: : Huh?
: {i}And I’ll stay quiet in case you don’t want Maya to hear.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}如果你不想让 Maya 听见，我就小声说。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Um...it feels kind of weird whispering when she’s right there...but what do you want?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嗯……她就在这儿还窃窃私语，感觉有点怪……不过你想要什么？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}It’s simple.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}很简单。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I’ll stay away from Sensei if you tell me you like him too.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}只要你告诉我你也喜欢他，我就离 Sensei 远点。{/i}

lines.en: scene girlbath25
: {i}What are you talking about? He’s my [uncle]...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你在说什么啊？他是我[uncle]……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Of course I don’t like him that way...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我当然不是那种喜欢他……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}So the only reason you feel weird about me liking him is because you guys are related? Not because you don’t want to be my love-rival?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}所以你对我喜欢他感到别扭的唯一原因，就是你们有血缘关系？而不是因为你不想成为我的情敌？{/i}

lines.en: : Uh-huh...
: Good! Then I guess this calls for a celebratory hug then, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 好！那看来这值得来个庆祝的拥抱了，不是吗？

lines.en: scene girlbath26
: Wait, what? We’re both na-
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？我们俩都光——

lines.en: scene girlbath27
: AHHH! GET OFF OF ME! YOU’RE ALL WET!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊！从我身上下来！你浑身都湿透了！

lines.en: : So are you, idiot! We’re in the bath!
lines.zh: : 你不也是吗，笨蛋！我们在洗澡啊！

lines.en: : AYANEEEE! STOP!
lines.zh: : AYANEEEE！停下！

lines.en: : {i}Those two have a weird relationship.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那两个人的关系真够怪的。{/i}

lines.en: scene black
scene bathmale3
: Ugh...Well, that sucks.
lines.zh: : 唉……好吧，真没劲。

lines.en: I wound up not being able to hear much of anything until Ami started screaming a few seconds ago.
lines.zh: 结果直到几秒前 Ami 开始尖叫，我几乎什么也没听到。

lines.en: Oh well.
lines.zh: 算了。

lines.en: I guess it wouldn’t be fair for me to hear everything the three of them talked about.
lines.zh: 我能把她们三个聊的所有内容都听去，本来也不公平吧。

lines.en: Some things are better left as a mystery I guess.
lines.zh: 有些事还是保持神秘比较好，我猜。

lines.en: But regardless, this was definitely relaxing.
lines.zh: 不过不管怎样，这一趟确实很放松。

lines.en: Maybe I’ll come back here sometime.
lines.zh: 也许我该找个时间再来。

lines.en: scene black
With or without the girls...
lines.zh: 有女孩子们陪着，或者没有……

lines.en: But preferably with.
lines.zh: 不过最好有。
